notes: Task 6 is frontend-only (dashboard empty-state + /projects/new create form). Full OWASP Top 10 sweep performed against pages/dashboard.vue, pages/projects/new.vue, their spec files, i18n locale additions, and the .gitignore anchor change. No vulnerabilities found. Detail: (A01) /projects/new and /dashboard are protected by auth.global.ts (fail-closed redirect to /auth/login for unauthenticated users); backend POST /api/v1/projects enforces user-scoped creation authoritatively. (A03 XSS) all user-influenced strings rendered via Vue mustache {{ }} and i18n t()/named-param interpolation — auto-escaped; no v-html or innerHTML usage anywhere in new code. (A04) zod client schema is UX-only; payload is also trimmed and empty description coerced to null before submit; backend remains source of truth. (A05) .gitignore anchor change from 'projects/' to '/projects/' correctly restricts the rule to the repo root — no top-level projects/ dir exists, and frontend/pages/projects/ + frontend/tests/pages/projects/ are now properly trackable; verified via `git check-ignore`. No previously-ignored sensitive directory becomes trackable. (A07/CSRF) projectsStore.create routes through useApi(), which centrally injects X-XSRF-TOKEN on non-safe methods and forwards credentials; no CSRF gap introduced. (A10) navigateTo(localePath('/dashboard')) is a static constant — no open-redirect surface. No hardcoded secrets in code, tests, or i18n. No new dependencies. No prototype-pollution sinks (no Object.assign with untrusted input, no JSON.parse of untrusted strings, no dynamic computed property writes).
